name: surface-reports-playback-state
description: The bare surface announces playback state changes on its own signals, with no dialog or shell between the caller and the core.

steps.name: playing
steps.note: The engine reports what the surface itself observes; there is no shell here to ask.

assertions.note: Only true once a decoded frame is actually on the surface, so this cannot pass on a surface that opened the file and rendered nothing.
Read from the core the surface owns, with no dialog cache in the middle - the shortest possible Qt-to-mpv path.
